maddeler.e:
تنتجبوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَجِبُوا (tantajibū) /tan.ta.d͡ʒi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# تُنْتَجَبُوا (tuntajabū) /tun.ta.d͡ʒa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
